_comment: Elecrow CrowPanel Advance 7.0-HMI (SKU DIS02170A): an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (16MB quad flash, 8MB octal PSRAM) behind a 7-inch 800x480 IPS parallel RGB panel with a GT911 capacitive touch controller. One firmware serves every board revision: the slow control lines sit behind a PCA9557 on V1.0-V1.2 and an STC8H1K28 board-control MCU on V1.3+, and the binding probes which at boot. Sources: Elecrow's V1.0-V1.5 schematics and V1.5 driver guide (Elecrow-RD/CrowPanel-Advance-7-HMI-ESP32-S3-AI-Powered-IPS-Touch-Screen-800x480) and the factory firmware.
_console: The USB-C port goes through a CH340K USB-UART bridge to UART0 (TXD0/RXD0), with the usual DTR/RTS auto-download circuit. The native USB-Serial/JTAG pins are not brought out.
_psram: N16R8 is 8MB octal PSRAM; the RGB framebuffer (800x480x2 = 768KB) lives there.
_buses: One I2C bus on GPIO15/16 carries the GT911 (0x5d), the PCA9557 expander (0x18) and the BM8563 RTC (0x51), and is also brought out on the HY2.0 I2C connector.

display._timing: Elecrow's current examples drive the panel at 18MHz (their maintenance baseline; older code used 16 and 21) with 8/4/8 porches on both axes, PCLK idle high.
display._pins: data0-4 = B3-B7, data5-10 = G2-G7, data11-15 = R3-R7 (the panel's low bits are tied off). The backlight is board-control line 1; the panel's RESET is an RC network, not a GPIO.

touch._pins: Reset is board-control line 2 (PCA9557 IO2 on V1.0, the STC's touch-recover command 250 on V1.3+); INT is GPIO1, which the binding drives low across reset to fix the address at 0x5d, as Elecrow's recovery sequence does.

audio._pins: Speaker: NS4168 on IO5 BCLK, IO6 LRCLK, IO4 SDIN. Microphone: an INMP441 (I2S: IO19 SCK, IO2 WS, IO20 SD) on V1.0, a PDM part (IO19 CLK, IO20 DATA) on V1.3+; 'auto' picks by the board controller found at boot. IO4-IO6 are shared with the microSD slot and the wireless socket, IO19/IO20 with the socket too; the function-select DIP switch picks which one they reach.
audio._expander: Amplifier shutdown is board-control line 4 and mute line 3 (high = off). On V1.0 they are PCA9557 IO4/IO3; on V1.3+ pulling shutdown low sends the STC's speaker-enable command 248, and there is no documented command for mute or for turning the amplifier off.

rtc._battery: A BM8563 (PCF8563-compatible; a PCF8563 on V1.5) at 0x51, backed by a CR1220 cell, so the system clock is restored from it at boot.

expander._outputs: Lines use PCA9557 numbering: 1 backlight, 2 touch reset, 3 amplifier mute, 4 amplifier shutdown. On an STC board each maps to its command (backlight 0-245 with brightness, 250 touch recovery, 248 speaker on). initialOutputs 0x14 / initialDirections 0xe1 apply to the PCA9557: touch out of reset, mute low, shutdown high, backlight off until the panel scans.

_storage: The TF slot is wired for SPI (IO5 SCK, IO6 MOSI, IO4 MISO) with its chip select tied active by a resistor, so it has no CS GPIO and cannot run SD_MMC. It shares IO4-IO6 with the speaker; the function-select DIP switch must be on the SD position for the card to answer.
_pinSharing: The function-select DIP switch routes IO4-IO6 to the speaker or the TF slot (or the wireless socket), never both, so the speaker and the card may name the same GPIOs.
_buzzer: The passive buzzer is on GPIO8 on V1.0 but driven by the STC (P2.7) on V1.3+, where Elecrow documents no command for it, so the target does not drive it.
_controls: BOOT is GPIO0, which is free once the board has booted (the wireless-module socket also uses it as BUSY, only when a module is fitted).
